# Loads default set of integrations. Do not remove.
default_config:

{{- if .Values.ingress.enabled }}
http:
  use_x_forwarded_for: true
  trusted_proxies:
    {{- range .Values.configuration.trusted_proxies }}
    - {{ . }}
    {{- end }}
{{- end}}
# Load frontend themes from the themes folder
frontend:
  themes: !include_dir_merge_named themes

automation: !include automations.yaml
script: !include scripts.yaml
scene: !include scenes.yaml

automation gitops: !include gitops/automations.yaml # matches mount path of gitops-config config map
climate gitops: !include gitops/climates.yaml # matches mount path of gitops-config config map
group: !include gitops/groups.yaml # matches mount path of gitops-config config map
switch gitops: !include gitops/switches.yaml # matches mount path of gitops-config config map

# Activate Bubble card module store & editor
template:
  - trigger:
      - trigger: event
        event_type: bubble_card_update_modules
    sensor:
      - name: "Bubble Card Modules"
        state: "saved"
        icon: "mdi:puzzle"
        attributes:
          modules: {{ `"{{ trigger.event.data.modules }}" `}}
          last_updated: {{ `"{{ trigger.event.data.last_updated }}" `}}

# Activate Amazon Alexa integration
alexa:
  smart_home:
    locale: de-DE
    filter:
      include_entities:
        - "vacuum.roborock_s7"
        - "switch.bett"
        - "switch.pc"
        - "switch.buero_stehlampe"
        - "climate.wohnzimmer"
        - "climate.buero"
        - "climate.schlafzimmer"

#!/bin/sh
echo "waiting for pre-existing pms database to uploaded..."

if [ -d "/config/Library" ]; then
  echo "PMS library already exists, exiting."
  exit 0
fi

# wait for the database archive to be manually copied to the server
while [ ! -f /pms.tgz ]; do sleep 2; done;

tar -xvzf /pms.tgz -C /config
rm pms.tgz

echo "Done."

/hr/ghcr.io-bjw-s-helm-app-template-immi.doc:
Immich is a self-hosted photo and video backup solution.

For immich, there are multiple helm deployments:

  • immich-web
  • immich-server
  • immich-typesense (this one)
  • immich-machine-learning
  • immich-microservices

For redis and postgres, there are multiple helm charts:

  • Redis: app-template/redis, bitnami/redis
  • PostgreSQL: operator cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg, bitnami bitnami/postgresql
